title: KSI Check Definition
description: The compliance-owned definition of how one FedRAMP 20x KSI is checked: what to query, how often, how to decide true/false/null, and how to word the result. A collector reads this file and emits KSI evidence records (schema/ksi-evidence.schema.json). Shared fields reuse the evidence schema so a check and the records it produces cannot drift apart.

duration.description: ISO 8601 duration limited to days, hours, minutes and seconds, for example PT24H or PT5M.

source.description: The system to query and the query to run. Copied into every record the check produces.

interval.description: How often a record must be produced. next_collection_due on each record is collected_at plus this interval.

timeout.description: How long the fetch may run before the collector gives up and emits result null.

evaluate.description: How to turn the raw response into true, false or null.

parameters.description: Constants the rule refers to by name, such as an allowed set. Kept here so a change to the interpretation is a reviewed change to this file.

extract.description: Named values pulled from the response. pass_when refers to these names.

jsonpath.description: Optional JSONPath into the response. Omit when the value cannot be expressed as a path; the description then has to be precise enough to implement.

description.description: Plain statement of what the value is and where it comes from.

pass_when.description: The rule, in terms of the extracted names and parameters, under which result is true. When collection succeeds and this rule does not hold, result is false.

null_when.description: The conditions under which result is null instead of true or false. Collection failure is always one of them.

rationale.description: Reviewer-facing wording for each result. {name} placeholders are filled by the evaluation step. The null template must use {failure_reason}.
